model_audit.target: Within 20 sessions, the favorable 3% barrier is reached before the adverse 3% barrier.

top.reason: No tested top model exceeded a 50% out-of-sample path hit rate with adequate samples.

methodology.lookahead_policy: Scores use current and prior observations only; future returns are labels used only after events are selected.
methodology.top_win_definition: A top event wins when the subsequent QQQ return is below 0%.
methodology.bottom_win_definition: A bottom event wins when the subsequent QQQ return is above 0%.
methodology.turning_point_hit_definition: Within 20 sessions, a favorable 3% move must occur before an adverse 3% move.
